text: Dear Chair and Colleagues, I've been contacted by several neighbours concerned about road safety on Snowdon Avenue. Residents regularly observe motorists accelerating onto Snowdon Avenue from Yonge Street. Snowdon Avenue currently has a signed 30km/h speed limit between Mt. Pleasant Road and Bocastle Avenue, due to speed humps that were previously implemented as a traffic calming measure. This motion will make the speed limit consistent throughout the entire street. Transportation Services staff do not object to the requested changes.

North York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 40km/h to 30km/h on Snowdon Avenue, between Yonge Street and Bocastle Avenue. 2. Reduced the speed limit from 40km/h to 30km/h on Snowdon Avenue, between Mt. Pleasant Road and Riverview Drive.
